title: Attribute the coding agent's reported run cost to the ledger and budget on completion
spec: When a managed coding-agent invocation completes, the agent's own reported usage/cost (for example Claude Code's reported total cost for the run) is discarded — the economic ledger and budget tracking never see it, so per-run cost attribution under-counts. Change the server's invocation completion path so a run cost reported in the completion payload is recorded against the invocation's cost attribution (ledger entry + budget spend), with a sensible fallback when no cost is reported.
